en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘No deed with doubt and denial will be of any benefit’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father in a marfu’ manner from abu la’ far (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘
No deed with doubt and denial will be of any benefit.’”
